baker-maera.persona: Flour-dusted, sharp-tongued, keeps three secrets and one oven that never cools. Helps runners who don't burn her shop twice.

courier-grey.persona: Polite as a closed door. Carries other people's endings in a leather satchel and never runs — walks as if already paid.

veyra-handler.persona: Silver pin, thinner smile. Hired you for a letter that was never meant to leave the counting-house. Offers partnership like a leash.
